entities.summary: Cromer, a notable figure in the history of Egypt, associated with Muhammad Ali Dynasty (1882–1922). Preceded by British Occupation and Urabi Revolt. Their legacy influenced Anglo-Egyptian Treaty and 1919 Revolution and Nominal Independence.
